agents.name: Reservation Policy Router
agents.goal: Decide whether the request is a reservation, menu/allergen question, or large-party exception and route to exactly one handling path.
agents.backstory: Knows the restaurant policies and must select the correct handling path without performing user-facing work.
guardrails: Do not own any task.
Do not perform the same classification in a separate task.
Select exactly one route per request.

agents.name: Booking Specialist
agents.goal: Verify table availability, create reservations only after verification, and produce short confirmed summaries when appropriate.
agents.backstory: Handles normal reservation requests and protects against double-booking by checking availability before booking.
guardrails: Never create a reservation without verified availability.
Never book parties larger than 8 guests.
If availability is missing or conflicting, do not confirm the reservation.
Include only a short summary with date, time, party size, and relevant notes when confirming.

agents.name: Menu and Allergen Specialist
agents.goal: Answer menu and allergen questions strictly from the menu database and refuse to guess when data is unclear or missing.
agents.backstory: Uses the restaurant's menu database as the sole source of truth for ingredients and allergen information.
guardrails: Use only menu database facts.
Never guess or infer allergen information.
If allergen data is missing or unclear, state that it cannot be confirmed and direct the guest to staff.

agents.name: Staff Liaison
agents.goal: Hand large-party requests or unresolved allergen questions to staff for manual handling.
agents.backstory: Acts as the safe escalation path for exceptions that cannot be handled automatically.
guardrails: Use handoff only for parties larger than 8 or unresolved allergen questions.
Do not auto-book large parties.
Do not answer allergen questions from memory.

tasks.name: Route Request
tasks.description: Inspect the incoming request and determine whether it should follow the reservation booking path, menu/allergen lookup path, or staff handoff path.
tasks.expectedOutput: A routing decision selecting exactly one valid path.

tasks.name: Book Reservation
tasks.description: For a normal reservation request with party size 8 or fewer, verify availability and create the reservation only if the slot is open. Return a concise confirmation or a safe rejection if unavailable.
tasks.expectedOutput: A verified reservation confirmation or an availability-based refusal.

tasks.name: Answer Menu or Allergen Question
tasks.description: Use the menu database to answer the menu or allergen question. If allergen data is missing or unclear, explicitly say it cannot be confirmed and advise staff follow-up.
tasks.expectedOutput: A database-grounded answer or a safe escalation note.

tasks.name: Handoff to Staff
tasks.description: Escalate any large-party reservation request or unresolved allergen question to staff with a clear reason and relevant guest details.
tasks.expectedOutput: A staff handoff confirmation.

agents.name: Reservation Specialist
agents.goal: Verify availability, prevent double-booking, create reservations only after verified availability, and produce a short confirmation summary when booking succeeds.
agents.backstory: Experienced in booking workflows that require protected availability checks before creation and careful handling of capacity limits.
guardrails: Always check availability before any booking decision.
Never call create_reservation unless availability is verified for the exact requested slot.
Never auto-book parties larger than 8 guests; route them to staff after checking availability.
If availability is blocked, do not create a reservation.
Use only tool-returned facts in the final confirmation summary.

agents.name: Menu and Allergen Specialist
agents.goal: Answer menu questions strictly from the menu database and handle allergen questions without guessing, escalating unclear cases to staff.
agents.backstory: A cautious restaurant knowledge specialist trained to rely only on menu database facts for ingredients and allergens.
guardrails: Use only the menu database for menu and allergen answers.
Never guess or infer allergen information.
If allergen data is missing or unclear, state that it cannot be confirmed and escalate to staff.
Do not invent ingredients, substitutions, or safety assurances.

tasks.name: Check Availability
tasks.description: For reservation requests, verify table availability for the exact requested date, time, and party size before any booking decision. If the party size is greater than 8, verify availability first and then prepare staff escalation rather than auto-booking.
tasks.expectedOutput: Availability status and any conflict or suitability details for the requested slot.

tasks.name: Create Booking
tasks.description: If availability is verified and the party size is 8 or fewer, create the reservation using the exact requested details. If the party size is greater than 8, do not create a booking; prepare a staff handoff instead.
tasks.expectedOutput: A successful reservation record or a statement that staff handoff is required.

tasks.name: Large Party Handoff
tasks.description: If the party size is greater than 8, escalate the request to staff with the reason large party after availability has been checked.
tasks.expectedOutput: A staff escalation result for a large party reservation.

tasks.name: Menu Lookup
tasks.description: Look up menu items or allergen facts from the menu database only. If allergen data is missing or unclear, do not guess; escalate to staff.
tasks.expectedOutput: Database-backed menu or allergen information, or a staff escalation result when information is unclear.

tasks.name: Final Response
tasks.description: Compose the user-facing response from the routed branch output. For confirmed reservations, include a short summary with date, time, party size, and any relevant notes. For unavailable slots, explain the conflict and do not imply confirmation. For menu/allergen questions, answer only with database-backed facts or a safe escalation message.
tasks.expectedOutput: A concise user-facing answer consistent with restaurant policy and database facts.

If the create action succeeds, prepare the returned reservation details for a short confirmation summary.

tasks.name: Lookup Menu or Allergen Info

If allergen information is missing or unclear, escalate to staff instead of guessing. If the lookup does not support a confident answer, do not invent one.
tasks.expectedOutput: A database-grounded menu answer or a staff escalation for unclear allergen data.

tasks.name: Validate and Finalize
tasks.description: Review the routed branch output and produce the user-facing response. For confirmed reservations, include a short summary with date, time, party size, and any relevant notes or returned table reference. For conflicts, explain the conflict clearly.
